text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Focus more on twisting your body from
your hips!
Imagine you're cutting
through the air like this!
See?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I find Seeking the Pearl and
King Halo
swinging brooms through the
air.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're doing some special training so
that King
can deal with a phobia of hers
with speed and
ease!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Said phobia is apparently a spiderweb
stretching
across a window. King Halo
has been put in
charge of cleaning, and
is now trying to approach
the web
without letting it enter her field of
vision.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I may have run away from it before, but
now,
after having undergone special
training...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I will not falter! Hraaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo courageously stands before
the
spiderweb, however...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What was that just now?! Stay away from
meee!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're trembling like a leaf... There's no
need to
push yourself so hard if you're
this scared. It's
really difficult to
overcome your fear all at once.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But look! You managed to walk up to it
so
bravely, and that's massive progress!
You can
leave the rest to me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, Pearl! I'm the one on
cleaning
duty today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Umamusume would never
shrink from
a task assigned specifically
to her... I must do it
myself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, King! All right, you go ahead. I'll be
your
backup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But before we tackle the challenge
again, how
about taking a breather to
muster some strength
for the task?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, while King Halo is taking a
break,
Seeking the Pearl dashes off
around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're good with synthesizers,
right? I
sometimes hear you playing in
the plaza. You've
got such a powerful
sound. Think you could help
me out a
little?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need you to lend me your soul-stirring
voice!
And you over there! I need you
too! Let that
unforgettable, angelic
voice of yours ring out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl goes around the
school
gathering a team of students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time we return to where King
Halo is
waiting, she's got a sizable
entourage with her!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Um, what's going on? Everyone's
brought
instruments... Are they part of
the school band or
something?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've assembled a resplendent cheering
squad
befitting of your standards. This
little number is
dedicated to our
wonderful King! A one, a two—a
one,
two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha gonna doooo? Oh, yeeeah,
yeeeah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bouncy synth and energetic chorus
that fills
the air make it feel as though
we're right in the
middle of a huge disco!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of kings! Oh, yeeeah, yeeeah!
Forever
reaching for the top, born to
rule! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows that you have it! ♪ Your
cool
pride echoes around the wooorld!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running away in fear doesn't suit you! ♪
Fire up
your engines and step onto the
road!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of kings! Oh, yeeeah, yeeeah! You
are the
first-class, first-rate Kiiing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You had me completely entranced!
That was
first-rate cheering, indeed!
Thank you all so
much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The rest is up to you. You have to
decide now
whether to show your back
and retreat, or move
forward and fight.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. After how you've just set the
stage, to
back down now would be to
sully my name!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a spiderweb, after all! YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Did I get it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Pearl! I... I did it! I defeated the
spiderweb!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Your unswaying
courage truly
touched my heart! That
was amazing, King! You
were absolutely
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's get started with our
next round
of special training! I'll act
like a bug, and you try
and swat me!
choice_data_list: At this rate, I might even get over my fear of bugs.
That was some powerful broom work!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Scuttle, scuttle, scuttle!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
S-stooop! Your acting is too realistic,
Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl begins a new kind of
special
training to help King Halo
conquer her fears!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This is exactly what we trained for!
If we
keep going, you'll soon be able to
catch real
spiders with your bare hands!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-with my bare hands?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you'll manage it in time. You're
the proud
and mighty King, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a little help from Seeking the
Pearl, King
Halo is able to finish all of
her cleaning duties!
